tasks.title: Move concrete Heartbeat lifecycle wiring from startup coordination into hosting
tasks.acceptanceCriteria: Follow the user's explicit same-module refactor: StartupCoordinator has no concrete Heartbeat reference, field, constructor dependency, resolution or lifecycle calls. Hosting owns optional Heartbeat activation, cancellation registration, cutoff and actual drain. Preserve one retained sequential startup operation and terminal outcome, complete construction before invocation, activation acknowledgement before readiness, failure health reporting, cancellation during activation, no premature/reopened dispatch/readiness and actual startup/HB settlement before dependency disposal. Use the smallest internal completion connection if needed to keep the final transition in the existing retained operation; no new public lifecycle/DI framework. Preserve optional-module absence, current APIs, source bytes, prior results/owners and the user-owned untracked example launch settings. Include focused meaningful regression/dependency-boundary tests, usage documentation and independent review in this task.
tasks.validation: Build affected native projects and execute focused Startup core/hosting and affected Heartbeat tests, real host readiness/cancellation/drain cases, a structural dependency guard, and the existing runnable source story as justified. Move activation-specific tests to exercise the actual hosting boundary rather than synthetic duplicated wiring. Preserve ordinary PerformanceObservation/ExtendedStress exclusions. Inspect original-task history, unchanged runtime dependencies/public surface and source hash; record actual counts, failures, costs and safe settlement within the same shared allocation. Serialize shared builds; no toolchain upgrade, new test harness, release campaign, publication or default-branch merge.
